name: Gate → ADVANCE: the task cleared, hand off to clean-room verify
description:
The advance router (design SB4, group 7D). When check_gate derives ADVANCE — the attempt measured green in the sandbox AND no structural floor rejected — the task's dev loop has converged. This rule records dev.task_cleared.<i> on the run: the per-task signal the clean-room verify station (group 8) chains on to prove the COMMITTED artifact builds cold (the final gate before a PR). G2: this fires no lifecycle transition; it records a fact, the verify station is a separate step.

TRIGGER = the check_gate LOOP terminal via the dev.gate_decision loop marker (check_gate stamps it on its own loop, value = the decision). This rule fires on agent.loop.role=coordinator AND dev.gate_decision eq "advance" — a single LITERAL eq, so it is snapshot-race-immune and #519-immune (no field-to-field). Exactly one of the three router rules matches a given gate loop (the decision has one value); dev.routed makes that one-shot restart-safe.

RUN BINDING: the cleared fact goes on the RUN (subject-override $entity.triple.agent.run.entity_id — the gate loop carries the run anchor), so the verify station reads it on the run.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps dev.routed=$entity.instance on the gate loop (the firing entity), guarded by dev.routed length_eq 0. The three routers SHARE this one loop marker: once any fires, the others are also extinguished (belt-and-suspenders — they are already mutually exclusive on the decision value). A fresh gate loop per attempt carries no dev.routed, so a later attempt's gate routes for free.

metadata.station: route advance — the cleared task hands off to clean-room verify (SB4, 7D)
metadata.trigger_rationale: fires on the check_gate loop's dev.gate_decision marker with a LITERAL eq "advance" — snapshot-race-immune, #519-immune. Mutually exclusive with the retry/escalate routers on the single decision value.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped dev.routed marker + length_eq 0 guard (shared by all three routers). add_triple is idempotent (upsert), so advance re-firing would be harmless; the marker keeps it uniform with the retry router (whose publish is NOT idempotent).
metadata.writer_note: dev.task_cleared.* and dev.routed are written by the dev-route-rule subsystem (G5) — one logical writer realized by the three router rule files (like run.awaiting_human's park realizations). Rule add_triple carries no Source, so the single vocab entries are not drifted.
